title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ContactInformation
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ContactInformation. Contains contact details for an entity.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ContactInformation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

postalAddress.description: Relationship. Postal address of the contact. Links to an Address entity.

email.description: Property. Email address of the contact.

phoneNumber.description: Property. Phone number of the contact.

url.description: Property. Resolvable link to a resource.
